editorial.title_zh: 欧盟CBAM申报格式和证书清缴实施规则征求意见至12月17日
editorial.title_en: EU opens feedback on CBAM declaration format and certificate surrender rules
editorial.summary_zh: 欧委会公众咨询条目Ares(2026)1634728显示：依据CBAM基本条例第6(6)条，拟制定申报标准格式、通过CBAM Registry提交申报的程序及证书清缴安排。反馈期2026年11月19日至12月17日，当前处于征求意见阶段，并非已生效的申报实施细则。
editorial.summary_en: Consultation on declaration format, registry submission and surrender arrangements is open 19 Nov–17 Dec 2026; this is not an enacted implementing regulation.
editorial.impact_zh: 钢厂与欧盟进口商可提前核对产品排放字段、申报主体和证书清缴操作流程；如需反馈，应在12月17日前查看草案及官方提交渠道，暂不能把草案当成现行合规义务。
editorial.impact_en: Importers and mills should prepare declaration data and review the draft before the feedback deadline; do not treat it as binding law.
editorial.coverage: 依据队列保留的欧委会原始倡议标题、Ares编号、官方摘录和OPEN时间；官方页面本轮未能直接打开，未核对草案附件或具体表格，限定事实，不标source_checked。
editorial.source_excerpt: Pursuant to Article 6(6) of the CBAM Regulation, the Commission is empowered to adopt implementing acts as regards to the establishment of the CBAM declarations. This implementing act will set out rules on the standard format of the CBAM declaration, including detailed information, the procedure for submitting the CBAM declaration via the CBAM registry and the arrangements for surrendering the CBAM certificates. Feedback status: OPEN. Feedback period: 2026-11-19T16:34:00Z to 2026-12-17T23:59:59Z. Topics: Customs, Taxation. Type of act: REG_IMPL. Reference: Ares(2026)1634728.
editorial.follow_up: 2026-12-17前核对草案全文、申报模板及反馈入口。

editorial.title_zh: 英国对韩国热轧中厚板实施最终反倾销措施：仅覆盖宽度不超过2100毫米产品
editorial.title_en: UK imposes definitive anti-dumping duties on South Korean hot-rolled plate up to 2,100 mm
editorial.summary_zh: 英国贸易救济署2026年11月19日官方新闻确认，贸易大臣决定对韩国原产热轧中厚板实施反倾销措施。英国TRA曾建议覆盖更宽产品，但政府因经济利益测试及英国境内宽于2100毫米产品缺乏持续生产，最终仅对宽度不超过2100毫米的产品征税，税率7.04%至23.07%。本次新闻稿未逐一列出各企业税率及所有税号，报关仍须依2026/32正式通知。
editorial.summary_en: UK TRA news dated 19 Nov confirms definitive AD measures of 7.04–23.07% only on Korean hot-rolled plate up to 2,100 mm, narrowed from the investigated scope on economic-interest grounds.
editorial.impact_zh: 韩国宽度≤2100毫米中厚板进入英国的到岸成本可能提高，宽度超过2100毫米的产品不能套用该税率。中国中厚板的潜在替代机会须另核英国对华措施、配额及认证；按宽度、生产企业和清关税号比较报价。
editorial.impact_en: Korean plate up to 2,100 mm faces higher UK costs. Chinese substitutes require separate origin-specific duties, quotas and qualification checks.
editorial.coverage: 2026-11-20读取英国TRA官方新闻原文，核对11月19日发布日期、7.04%–23.07%范围、2100毫米宽度界限及经济利益测试。新闻稿未给出完整企业税率/税号；应结合正式2026/32通知。
editorial.source_excerpt: Following a TRA investigation, the Secretary of State has decided to apply a new anti-dumping measure on imports of hot-rolled steel plate from South Korea. The Secretary of State has applied a new anti-dumping measure on imports of hot-rolled steel plate from South Korea, following an investigation by the TRA. The TRA determined that hot-rolled steel plate from South Korea has been or is being dumped into the UK and that this has caused or is causing injury to the UK production industry. The TRA was therefore required to recommend a measure on the full scope of hot-rolled steel plate from So…
editorial.follow_up: 核对2026/32正式通知中的企业税率、CN编码和商业发票条件。

editorial.title_zh: 欧盟CBAM于2027年1月1日扩展至挪威和冰岛，50吨门槛跨三地累计
editorial.title_en: EU CBAM extends to Norway and Iceland from 1 January 2027
editorial.summary_zh: 欧委会税务与海关总司2026年11月18日官方公告确认，EEA联合委员会第283/2026号决定于11月18日生效；2027年1月1日起挪威和冰岛进口CBAM覆盖货物适用相同规则。钢铁、铝、化肥、水泥年度50吨门槛在欧盟、挪威和冰岛合计计算，电力和氢不适用该吨数门槛；三地授权申报人资格相互承认。挪威和冰岛进口商须办理授权，2027年3月31日前申请者有过渡便利；列支敦士登不在CBAM区域。
editorial.summary_en: EEA Decision 283/2026 entered into force 18 Nov. From 1 Jan 2027 CBAM extends to Norway and Iceland. The 50-tonne annual threshold for four sectors is cumulative across the EU and both EEA states; authorisations are mutually recognised.
editorial.impact_zh: 向挪威及冰岛出口板坯、热轧/冷轧等涉案产品需准备CBAM排放数据，并与欧洲集团进口商核对跨三地累计进口量及授权状态；不能将50吨门槛分拆适用。
editorial.impact_en: Steel exporters should prepare emissions data and coordinate group-wide import volumes and declarant authorisations across the three customs territories.
editorial.coverage: 2026-11-20直接读取欧委会DG TAXUD 11月18日官方全文，核对EEA决定、2027-01-01实施、50吨累计门槛、申报人互认、2027-03-31过渡与列支敦士登排除。
editorial.source_excerpt: Extension of CBAM to Iceland and Norway EEA Joint Committee Decision No 283/2026, which extends CBAM to Iceland and Norway, entered into force on 18 November 2026. From 1 January 2027, the same CBAM rules will apply to imports of covered goods into Iceland and Norway as to imports into the EU.
